calling_convention.inputs: $fp points to the current 0x100-byte object record

reads: position words at record offsets 0x04 and 0x08
signed direction halfwords at offsets 0x7c and 0x80
one-shot movement at 0x7e, persistent movement at 0x84, and decay at 0x86
writes: consumed one-shot movement at record offset 0x7e
updated position words at offsets 0x04 and 0x08

original.discovery_notes: The type-0x1a per-frame handler at 0x88004e54 calls this routine before gravity, animation, and scale growth. Entry 0x88004180 loads the one-shot amount as signed; 0x88004188 is a distinct unsigned alternate entry. The semantic name is limited to the verified record transformations.

commands: flatpak run org.mamedev.MAME kinst -rompath assets/ki1 -debug -nodrc -debugscript mame/oracle_ki15d_88004180.cmd -video none -sound none -nothrottle -skip_gameinfo -seconds_to_run 4 -cfg_directory work/mame/cfg -diff_directory work/mame/diff
verification.notes: Four controlled R4600 calls cover the live type-0x1a state, a signed negative one-shot amount, the early return, position wraparound, and decay clamping. The native test reconstructs and compares the complete 1 MiB mapped RAM image after every call.
